headers: Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) provided when you are ineligible for an HSA

rows.Health Savings Account (HSA): You can take this account with you when you change plans, separate or retire from federal service. If you do not enroll in another HDHP, you can no longer contribute to your HSA. See Section 1, Health Savings Account (HSA) or the beginning of this section for HSA eligibility.
rows.Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) p: If you retire and remain in this HDHP, you may continue to use and accumulate credits in your HRA. If you terminate employment or change health plans, only eligible expenses incurred while covered under the HDHP will be eligible for reimbursement subject to timely filing requirements. Unused funds are forfeited.

rows.Health Savings Account (HSA): Yes, accumulates without a maximum cap.
rows.Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) p: Yes, accumulates without a maximum cap.

rows.Health Savings Account (HSA): You may access your HSA on-line at geha.com/ HDHP-HSA.
rows.Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) p: Your HRA account balance will be available on- line through your Member Account at geha.com/ My-Member-Portal. To request reimbursement from your HRA account for qualified out-of- pocket medical expenses that are not submitted to G.E.H.A by your doctor, hospital, dentist or pharmacy, call G.E.H.A's Customer Care at 800-821-6136 or go to geha.com/My-Member- Portal to obtain our Health Reimbursement Arrangement Claim Form. This form is also used to request reimbursement from your HRA for Medicare premiums.
